lecture_beats.subject: Reversible maps, conserved sectors, and information-preserving flow
Complete mechanical states and first-order Newtonian flow
One-variable Legendre transform by graph, area, and variation
Many variables and the mechanical velocity-momentum transform
Derivation and structure of Hamilton's equations
Invertibility, friction, fields, and boundaries of the construction
Ordinary particle and direct proof of energy conservation
Energy contours, incompressibility, and bounded versus running motion
Nonlinear momentum and the distinction between total and usable energy
General observables and the Poisson-bracket definition
Canonical bracket checks, conservation, and discovery question
Explicit time dependence and external sources

resolved_source_issues.issue: The spoken red-dot analogy blends reversibility and incompressibility.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter distinguishes invertibility from the divergence-free consequence of canonical Hamiltonian flow.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The complementary-area formula suppresses additive-constant assumptions.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The normalized area construction is separated from the invariant definition H equals PV minus L.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The lecture describes non-invertible systems as physically ill-defined.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The ordinary transform failure is retained while legitimate constrained systems are identified separately.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Automatic captions are heavily corrupted during the question locating the Legendre transform.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Only the verified velocity-to-momentum procedure and the displayed cancellation are reconstructed.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The friction and field discussion mixes reduced and complete systems.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter separates apparent dissipation from Hamiltonian evolution of the enlarged particle-plus-environment system.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The cubic Hamiltonian has a non-global momentum-velocity inverse.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The example is retained for its intended nonlinearity and supplied with the regularity caveat.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Automatic captions insert an unrelated phrase during the conservation criterion.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The criterion is restored from the completed Poisson-bracket derivation.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The late sign-convention exchange is repetitive and partially garbled.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: One antisymmetric convention is stated and checked against both canonical equations; the broad-use remark is assigned to Legendre transforms.
